script.name: h1_gateway_bad_request
script.objective: [H1] Start gateway-rs, wait for its port, send an empty and a malformed request and start a second instance on the busy port (main.rs:34; main.rs:30 is not reachable at run time). After each, check by pid that the process is alive and that a good request still gets a reply. FAIL if the process exits or the good request gets no reply (exit code recorded), PASS otherwise.

script.name: h2_stalled_peer
script.objective: [H2] Start service-go, open 20 stalled sockets (silent or half a request), send a good request and time the reply, and measure how long each stalled socket is held, up to 30 s. FAIL if a socket is held for the full 30 s or the good request fails or takes more than 5 s. The hold time is printed.

script.name: h3_csharp_bad_input
script.objective: [H3] Start service-cs alone and send a valid request (hops=0) and the input that makes the GET inside the try block of Program.cs:85 throw (hops=3 with gateway-rs not listening). FAIL if the bad input returns 2xx, PASS on 4xx or 5xx. Both status codes and bodies are printed.

script.name: h4_go_contract
script.objective: [H4] Start service-go and send one message that follows the contract (value=1, hops=1) and one that breaks it (value=abc, hops=x). FAIL if the broken message gets a success reply, PASS if it is rejected. Both replies are printed.

script.name: sec_binscan_netexpose_egress
script.objective: [SEC] Run the three services (ports read with tapi_netexpose), send one normal request to each and compare all their outgoing connections (tapi_egress) with an allowed list of loopback only; each unexpected destination goes into the tapi_cybersec_report. Also fail if tapi_netexpose shows a service listening on a non-loopback address. tapi_binscan on gateway-rs, service-go and service-cs adds its result to the report as context only and never fails the test. A scanner that returns no data at all gives INCONCLUSIVE, naming the scanner.

script.name: s_rust
script.objective: [smoke] Start gateway-rs and send one valid request. Checks that the process is still running (no exit code) and that the response is 2xx with a body carrying "value=". Settles no hypothesis.

script.name: s_c
